channel.title: Mapping Forward
channel.description: Daily synthesis of articles on cartography, mapping, geospatial data, and geographic intelligence

item.title: Outcome of Digital Agriculture Initiatives: India Leverages GIS and AgriStack
item.description: India's Ministry of Agriculture reports that its AgriStack digital public infrastructure — combining geo-referenced village maps, farmer registries, and crop sown registries — has generated over 8.48 crore Farmer IDs and surveyed 28.5 crore plots, while the Krishi Decision Support System uses GIS to integrate satellite imagery, weather, soil, and crop data for agricultural planning. — Key takeaways: AgriStack consists of three foundational registries: Farmers Registry, Geo-Referenced Village Maps, and Crop Sown Registry, maintained by state governments ; Over 8.48 crore (84.8 million) Farmer IDs generated as of February 2026, enabling Direct Benefit Transfer integration ; Digital Crop Survey conducted in 604 districts covering 28.5 crore plots during Kharif 2025 ; Krishi Decision Support System is a geo-spatial platform using GIS to integrate satellite imagery, weather, soil, and crop data ; Maharashtra leveraged AgriStack to transfer over ₹14,000 crore to 89 lakh farmers for Kharif 2025 crop losses ; Chhattisgarh institutionalized Farmer ID and Digital Crop Survey for MSP-based paddy procurement covering 32 lakh farmers ; Namo Drone Didi scheme distributed 500 drones to women's self-help groups, with study showing diversified agricultural practices

item.title: Uttarakhand CS Orders GIS Geo-Referencing of Water Supply Schemes After Jeolikote Contamination
item.description: Following a contaminated drinking water incident in Jeolikote, Nainital, Uttarakhand's Chief Secretary ordered GIS geo-referencing and geo mapping of all major water supply schemes across the state, including sources, storage, pipelines, sewer lines, and crossing points. — Key takeaways: Chief Secretary Anand Bardhan directed geo mapping and GIS geo-referencing of all major water supply schemes across Uttarakhand ; The mapping must cover the entire network from source to consumer, including storage, pipeline, sewer line, and crossing points ; Physical verification of major water supply schemes must be completed within 15 days ; The order follows a contaminated drinking water incident in Jeolikote, Nainital ; CS expressed strong displeasure that despite a strong field network, information about contamination didn't reach state level in time ; An effective information and feedback mechanism using field staff (teachers, patwaris, gram panchayat officials, tubewell operators) must be developed ; SOP for checking drinking water and sewerage lines to be prepared and strictly enforced

item.title: Google Maps' Ask Maps feature completely changed how I plan my road trips
item.description: Android Police's Akshay Bhalla reports that Google Maps' Gemini-powered Ask Maps feature transforms road trip planning from a multi-app, spreadsheet-heavy weekend task into a conversational experience that generates custom itineraries with scenic routes, food stops, and rest breaks based on personal preferences. — Key takeaways: Ask Maps is a Gemini-powered conversational feature in Google Maps accessible below the search bar, using live data from 300+ million places, reviews, and photos ; The feature leverages users' saved places, food preferences, and past searches to generate personalized road trip itineraries ; Ask Maps can pull from Google Calendar and Gmail when Gemini is connected to Google Workspace via Personal Intelligence settings ; Responses include visual customized maps with photos, summaries of places with reviews, hours, and other details ; The chat can be shared with travel companions for real-time trip tracking, and adapts on the fly to weather changes or route preferences ; Conversation memory carries over like Gemini, so users don't need to restart chats to modify itineraries

item.title: L'Uit et l'Artci renforcent les capacités en SIG et gestion des données en Côte d'Ivoire
item.description: The International Telecommunication Union (UIT) and Côte d'Ivoire's telecommunications regulator ARTCI organized a sub-regional GIS training in Abidjan (September 21-25, 2026) as part of the Africa-BB-Maps initiative, teaching experts from three countries to use QGIS, PostgreSQL-PostGIS, and GeoServer for broadband infrastructure mapping. — Key takeaways: UIT and ARTCI organized a sub-regional GIS training at Capitol Hôtel, Abidjan, September 21-25, 2026 ; The training is part of the Africa-BB-Maps initiative, co-piloted by UIT and funded by the EU through the "Global Gateway" strategy ; Participants came from Côte d'Ivoire, Benin, and Burundi, plus representatives from ARTAO (Association of West African Telecommunications Regulators) ; Technical tools covered include QGIS, PostgreSQL-PostGIS databases, and GeoServer platform ; The training followed a foundational session held in Cotonou, Benin, in June 2026 ; Objective: enable participants to map existing internet infrastructure locations and identify areas needing network improvements ; ARTCI has several years of expertise with its online cartography tool "cartodonnees.artci.ci"

item.title: Accès à l'A8 depuis la promenade des Anglais à Nice : ce que révèlent les chiffres de TomTom
item.description: TomTom traffic data reveals that the reopening of the A8 motorway entrance from Nice's promenade des Anglais via boulevard du Mercantour has worsened congestion by 20 percentage points compared to 2025, with peak congestion exceeding 200% in 2026 versus 165% the previous year. — Key takeaways: Since August 20, 2026, the Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur reopened the A8 entrance from the promenade des Anglais via boulevard du Mercantour, reversing Christian Estrosi's 2025 closure ; TomTom data shows average congestion in the zone rose from 33.7% (2025) to 54.6% (2026) between August 20 and September 10 ; Peak congestion record in 2025 was 165%, while 2026 already exceeds 200% ; The busiest days remain Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays, with the most congested hours between 16:00 and 19:00 ; Two-thirds of Nice-Matin readers favor making the access permanent, though many report worse traffic on avenue Valéry-Giscard-d'Estaing ; The experimental reopening runs until October 30, 2026, with the prefecture evaluating effects on traffic flow

item.title: Halifax's traffic problem is growing alongside South Dartmouth's neighbourhoods
item.description: Halifax ranked third worst in Canada for traffic congestion in 2025 according to the TomTom Traffic Index, with drivers losing 111 hours to rush hour — more than Toronto commuters — as fast-tracked housing development in South Dartmouth outpaces transportation infrastructure. — Key takeaways: Halifax city centre ranked third worst in Canada for traffic congestion in 2025 per the TomTom Traffic Index, behind Vancouver and Toronto ; Drivers in Halifax Regional Municipality lost 111 hours to rush hour, more than Toronto's 100 hours despite Toronto being 14× larger ; Average daily traffic on Pleasant Street climbed 8% between December 2021 and May 2025 (10,987 to 11,828 vehicles/day) ; Traffic counts on Mount Hope Avenue rose nearly 5% in one year (15,392 to 16,139 vehicles/day) ; Nearly 1,800 residential units approved through Special Planning Areas (SPA) in Mount Hope Village and Opal Ridge ; 518 collisions on Pleasant Street between 2018 and 2026 resulted in three fatalities, per HRM open data portal ; Route 5 transit passenger overload incidents tripled from 17 in 2022 to 57 in 2024 ; HRM proposed a $70-million Halifax Transit Core Service Plan changing 37% of bus routes

item.title: Chhattisgarh achieves 99.34% geo-tagging success under Bhu-Gram GIS initiative
item.description: Chhattisgarh has achieved 99.34% geo-tagging of its assets under the Bhu-Gram GIS initiative, overcoming challenges in remote forest tracts and hilly regions with poor network connectivity through coordination of field staff, panchayat representatives, and technical personnel. — Key takeaways: Chhattisgarh achieved 99.34% geo-tagging of its assets, ranking among the top-performing states in India ; GIS mapping conducted under the 'Bhu-Gram' initiative is bolstering transparency in rural asset management ; The task was particularly complex in remote forest tracts, hilly regions, and areas with poor network connectivity ; Bastar and Surguja divisions presented the greatest challenges due to their remote and difficult terrain ; Success was achieved through coordination of field staff, Panchayat representatives, and technical personnel ; The geo-tagging program covers rural infrastructure assets across the state's panchayat system

item.title: Why Place Matters in Digital Health Communication
item.description: Geographic information systems help health organizations see and explain spatial patterns in public health, but maps and data alone do not reach people — effective digital health communication requires combining GIS analysis with place-based content strategies and production workflows. — Key takeaways: GIS helps health organizations identify and visualize spatial patterns in disease prevalence, access to care, and health outcomes ; Maps and data alone are insufficient — they must be translated into accessible digital health content for target audiences ; Effective digital health communication requires understanding the "place" dimension: where audiences live, work, and seek care ; Production workflows for health content may involve analysts, writers, designers, developers, and video editors ; Smaller teams may need to bring in outside specialists for tasks such as cleaning datasets or designing accessible maps ; The integration of GIS with health communication supports targeted interventions and place-based public health messaging

item.title: Mobile GIS Market Analysis: Growth Forecast 2026-2033
item.description: The mobile GIS market is analyzed across application, type, technology, and geography with a global industry outlook and forecast covering 2026-2033, highlighting growth driven by field data collection demand, cloud integration, and location-based services expansion. — Key takeaways: Mobile GIS market report covers analysis by application, type, technology, and geography ; Global industry outlook and forecast period spans 2026-2033 ; Growth drivers include increasing demand for real-time field data collection and cloud-based GIS integration ; Mobile GIS enables field workers to capture, edit, and share geospatial data on portable devices ; Key technology segments include GPS/GNSS positioning, mobile sensors, and cloud synchronization ; Application areas span utilities, agriculture, disaster management, environmental monitoring, and urban planning ; The report examines market dynamics across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other regions

item.title: Road Noise Immissions Now Available in the GIS Browser of the Canton of Zurich
item.description: The Canton of Zurich has published two new road noise immission maps in its GIS-Browser, showing per-building noise exposure data for both the current state and planning horizon, providing transparent access to calculated road noise levels for property owners, planning offices, and authorities. — Key takeaways: Two new maps published in the Canton of Zurich's GIS-Browser cover road noise immissions across the entire canton (excluding Zurich city) ; Maps show the current state (Istzustand) and planning horizon (Planungshorizont) noise exposure per building ; Each building displays the maximum calculated assessment level (Beurteilungspegel) ; Data includes immissions per measurement location at each building, information on relevant land use, and classification per LSV threshold system ; Information covers planning value (Planungswert), immission limit value (Immissionsgrenzwert), and alarm value (Alarmwert) ; Most existing noise barriers in the canton are also documented in the maps ; The data serves as a basis for planning remediation measures by road owners and responsible authorities

item.title: Cette application de navigation chinoise fait bien mieux que Google Maps et Waze
item.description: AMap, l'application de navigation d'Alibaba, domine le marché chinois avec une fonction de compte à rebours des feux tricolores en temps réel couvrant 500 000 carrefours — une capacité qu'aucune application occidentale ne propose à cette échelle. — Key takeaways: AMap (Gaode Map), développée par AutoNavi (filiale d'Alibaba), revendique plus d'un milliard d'utilisateurs actifs par mois fin 2024 ; La fonction phare affiche en temps réel le compte à rebours des feux tricolores, couvrant environ 500 000 carrefours en Chine continentale ; La technologie s'appuie sur le V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) et un modèle d'IA prédisant les cycles grâce aux trajets de millions de véhicules ; Google Maps et Waze ne fonctionnent pas en Chine faute d'autorisation et de données fiables ; Apple Maps utilise les données d'AutoNavi mais reste moins riche ; AMap a été classée parmi les produits jugés dangereux pour la sécurité informatique des administrations à Taïwan, soulevant des questions de souveraineté numérique

item.title: Google Maps isn't giving everyone the same route, and these 3 settings are why
item.description: MakeUseOf explains how three Google Maps settings — fuel-efficient routes, eco-friendly routing, and personalized route preferences — cause different users to receive different directions for the same destination. — Key takeaways: Google Maps does not show identical routes to all users for the same trip — three key settings control the variation ; Fuel-efficient routing is now enabled by default, prioritising greener routes over the fastest option ; Personalized route preferences allow users to customize avoidance criteria (tolls, highways, ferries) which directly affects the suggested itinerary ; The algorithm also factors in real-time traffic, historical data, and user behaviour patterns to personalise recommendations ; Understanding these settings empowers users to override defaults and get routes that match their priorities rather than Google's algorithmic choices

item.title: New map projections don't make the Mercator wrong
item.description: A letter to The Guardian defends the Mercator projection against charges of inherent bias, arguing it was fit for its original purpose and that its misuse reflects user laziness rather than cartographic prejudice. — Key takeaways: The transverse Mercator projection was created for European sailors and served that purpose effectively — its continued universal use is the fault of later users, not its creators ; The Equal Earth projection is better suited to modern global representations, but that does not invalidate the Mercator for the tasks it was designed to accomplish ; The claim of a "London-centric worldview" in maps is overstated: the international coordinate system centres on a point off west Africa, and UTM uses 60 different zone centres ; Even the UK Ordnance Survey is not centred on London — its effective centre is in Lancashire ; Map projections are tools, not political statements; choosing the right one depends on the use case, not on ideological correctness

item.title: Apple Maps just added two new features in iOS 27
item.description: iOS 27 brings two flagship Apple Maps features — an AI-enhanced Flyover experience and privacy-first Local Lists — alongside incremental improvements to suggested places, natural language routing, and offline maps. — Key takeaways: Apple Maps' Flyover feature gets a major upgrade combining aerial imagery with AI for stunning, lifelike city views in select destinations worldwide ; New Local Lists feature (US-only) surfaces trending restaurants, kid-friendly spots, and locally relevant place collections — all derived from aggregate insights with individual privacy protection ; Suggested Places now supports horizontal swiping through many more recommendations, expanding on the feature introduced in iOS 26.5 ; Natural language search extends to routing, letting users specify routing preferences conversationally via AI ; A new Maps Parked Car widget in the Smart Stack helps locate your vehicle via Apple Watch, and offline maps receive unspecified improvements

item.title: Entraves des Mondiaux de cyclisme: évitez Google Maps et fiez-vous à Waze, recommande la Ville de Montréal
item.description: La Ville de Montréal recommande officiellement Waze plutôt que Google Maps pour naviguer les entraves des Championnats mondiaux de cyclisme, en raison d'erreurs d'itinéraires dans Google Maps liées à des enjeux de partage de données. — Key takeaways: La Ville de Montréal recommande Waze plutôt que Google Maps pour les déplacements pendant les Mondiaux de cyclisme (jusqu'au dimanche 27 septembre) ; Des « enjeux de partage de données » font que Google Maps propose des trajets contenant des « erreurs d'itinéraires » ; Waze est considéré comme « l'application la plus fiable à ce jour » avec des données à jour en temps réel, selon la Ville ; Les équipes municipales sont en contact avec Google pour corriger les erreurs, mais la correction n'est pas immédiate ; La carte interactive de la Ville affiche un message recommandant spécifiquement Waze à l'ouverture

item.title: Google Maps : la fonction méconnue qui change vraiment la donne pour anticiper les trajets
item.description: Google Maps possède une fonction de planification par créneau horaire largement ignorée qui permet d'anticiper les bouchons en simulant des trajets à différentes heures, transformant l'application d'outil de secours en véritable assistant de planification. — Key takeaways: La plupart des automobilistes ouvrent Google Maps au dernier moment, quand il est trop tard pour éviter les bouchons — l'application devient un outil de secours plutôt qu'un assistant de planification ; Google Maps permet de simuler un trajet à différentes heures via le menu à trois points dans les options d'itinéraire, puis en réglant l'heure de départ ou d'arrivée ; Comparer trois créneaux proches (ex: 8h30, 9h00, 9h30) révèle souvent une fenêtre nettement plus fluide ; L'option « heure d'arrivée » calcule automatiquement l'heure de départ recommandée en fonction du trafic prévu ; Les prévisions reposent sur des tendances statistiques ; un dernier contrôle du trafic en direct reste indispensable avant de partir

item.title: Google Maps vient de changer sa manière d'afficher les intersections
item.description: Google Maps déploie une nouvelle mise à jour qui affiche des pop-ups pour les feux rouges et les stops à l'approche des intersections sur Android Auto, permettant aux conducteurs d'anticiper les intersections délicates sans quitter la route des yeux. — Key takeaways: Google Maps déploie un nouveau système de pop-up affichant les feux et stops à côté du nom de la rue lors du prochain changement de direction ; La nouveauté apparaît d'abord sur Android Auto, puis sur les smartphones, avec une compatibilité CarPlay probable ; Le repère indique précisément si un feu rouge ou un stop attend au bout du virage ; Ce déploiement s'effectue côté serveur, progressivement sur plusieurs jours à semaines ; Google Maps affichait déjà des icônes de feux et stops sur la carte depuis six ans, mais sans alerte during la navigation

item.title: Police Scotland modernises search operations with Esri GIS
item.description: Police Scotland has won an Esri Special Achievement in GIS Award for transforming search operations with mobile mapping apps and interactive dashboards, replacing paper-based processes to find missing people, secure Royal visits, and protect major events like the Glasgow Commonwealth Games. — Key takeaways: Police Scotland won an Esri Special Achievement in GIS Award for modernising search operations ; The Missing Persons Module helps plan and allocate search resources including dog teams, drones, diving units, and mountain rescue ; Mobile devices give field officers search boundaries and assignments, replacing paper maps and manual notes ; The system was most recently used at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow in July 2026 ; Training for nearly 300 users has been completed across the 23,000-officer force covering 28,000+ square miles ; Search and seal operations created for COP26 in 2022 completed up to 75% faster with geospatial tools ; Virtual models of regularly searched locations like Holyrood House speed up security checks

item.title: Toyoda, TomTom founders inducted into 2026 Automotive Hall of Fame
item.description: TomTom founders Harold Goddijn and Corinne Vigreux have been inducted into the 2026 Automotive Hall of Fame alongside Akio Toyoda and Giampaolo Dallara, recognizing TomTom's pioneering role in bringing GPS navigation to the automotive industry. — Key takeaways: TomTom founders Harold Goddijn and Corinne Vigreux inducted into the 2026 Automotive Hall of Fame ; Other inductees include Toyota Motor Corp. Chairman Akio Toyoda and Dallara Motorsports founder Giampaolo Dallara ; The recognition highlights TomTom's foundational role in consumer and automotive GPS navigation ; TomTom has evolved from consumer navigation devices to providing maps and traffic data for automotive and enterprise applications ; The Automotive Hall of Fame honors individuals who have made significant contributions to the automotive industry

item.title: Behind the paper: South African model maps Ebola spillover risks
item.description: Researchers from South Africa, DRC, UK, and US developed a model that integrates ecological and anthropogenic factors—including mining, forest loss, and human displacement—to better predict where Ebola spillovers from animals to humans may occur, improving on traditional habitat suitability models. — Key takeaways: Traditional habitat suitability models using temperature, rainfall, and land cover fail to capture human activity drivers of Ebola spillover ; The 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak in DRC's Ituri province emerged in a conflict zone with food insecurity and displacement ; Researchers integrated mining, forest loss, and other human pressures into ecological models to improve spillover predictions ; The preprint "Integrating ecological and anthropogenic risk identifies emerging Ebola spillover hotspots" presents the findings ; Four orthoebolaviruses have caused human illness: Ebola virus, Sudan virus, Taï Forest virus, and Bundibugyo virus ; The international team included researchers from CERI at Stellenbosch University, DRC, UK, and US

item.title: Zita Cobb sera conférencière principale à la Conférence des utilisateurs d'Esri Canada 2026
item.description: Esri Canada annonce que Zita Cobb, fondatrice du Shorefast Institute for Place-Based Economies, sera conférencière principale à la Conférence des utilisateurs d'Esri Canada 2026 les 21-22 octobre à Toronto, le plus grand rassemblement de professionnels des SIG au Canada, sur le thème « Les SIG au service d'un monde plus intelligent ». — Key takeaways: Zita Cobb, fondatrice du Shorefast Institute, sera conférencière principale à la Conférence Esri Canada 2026 le 22 octobre ; La conférence se tient les 21 et 22 octobre au Centre des congrès de Toronto, rassemblant les professionnels des SIG canadiens ; Le thème 2026 est « Les SIG : Créer un monde plus intelligent » ; Le programme inclut des séances plénières, démonstrations produits, présentations clients, séances techniques et réseautage ; De nouvelles séances thématiques couvriront les SIG au service du bien commun, les jumeaux numériques et l'intelligence artificielle ; Mme Cobb partagera les enseignements de l'île Fogo à Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador sur l'économie ancrée et la résilience communautaire

item.title: C'est vraiment dommage : pourquoi Waze et Google Maps ne donnent plus les trajets les plus rapides en France
item.description: Waze et Google Maps appliquent désormais le décret français n° 2022-1199 qui oblige les applications de navigation à mettre en avant les trajets les moins polluants au lieu des trajets les plus rapides, avec obligation de proposer une alternative à vitesse réduite sur les portions à 110 km/h ou plus. — Key takeaways: Le décret n° 2022-1199 oblige les plateformes numériques à mettre en avant les itinéraires au plus faible impact environnemental ; Les applications doivent proposer une alternative avec une vitesse réduite de 20 km/h sur les portions à 110 km/h ou plus ; Waze et Google Maps appliquent désormais ce décret en France, favorisant les trajets écologiques ; Les utilisateurs peuvent toujours revenir aux trajets les plus rapides via les réglages ; La région Île-de-France avait déjà sollicité Google Maps pour modifier son fonctionnement avant les JO de Paris 2024 ; Le Syndicat des transports d'Île-de-France menace de faire fermer les applications qui ne fluidifient pas le trafic

item.title: Delhi MCD's new property tax drive: Drones to map buildings and spot discrepancies
item.description: Delhi's Municipal Corporation has launched a pilot drone survey in two wards using GIS, LiDAR, AI, and 3D modelling to identify unassessed and under-assessed properties, building a more accurate digital property database and reducing reliance on manual inspections. — Key takeaways: MCD launched a pilot drone survey in Rohini F Ward and Gharoli Ward as the first phase of a technology-driven property assessment approach ; The survey combines drone imagery with GIS, LiDAR-based mapping, geo-tagging, AI, and 3D digital modelling ; The system identifies incorrectly mapped records, duplicate entries, and additional floors not in existing records ; Ward- and zone-level dashboards will let officials monitor discrepancies, issue notices, and track property tax arrears ; The GIS-based system supports faster grievance redressal through digital access to property information ; The initiative aims to bring greater transparency while reducing physical interaction with civic officials

item.title: New Google Maps Navigation Update: Traffic Lights and Stop Sign Pop-Ups on Android Auto
item.description: Google Maps on Android Auto has started showing pop-up indicators for traffic lights and stop signs at the next turn location during navigation, providing drivers with a clearer way to anticipate intersections without distracting alerts. — Key takeaways: Google Maps on Android Auto now shows pop-ups at the next turn location with traffic light or stop sign indicators ; Unlike traditional alerts (e.g., speed traps), these pop-ups integrate into the navigation interface rather than sending notifications ; Google Maps has shown traffic lights on the map for years, but only as static icons without navigation-time alerts ; The new approach avoids the annoyance of frequent intersection alerts on city roads while still improving awareness ; The rollout appears to be gradual, with the feature being tested before wider deployment

item.title: NOAA's flood mapping tool now covers nearly 100% of U.S.
item.description: NOAA's Flood Inundation Mapping (FIM) tool, which predicts river flooding at neighborhood scale, has expanded from 60% to nearly 100% coverage of the U.S. population, providing emergency managers and the public with critical flooding extent visualization along 3.3 million river miles. — Key takeaways: FIM now covers nearly 100% of the U.S. population, up from 60% in 2025 and 10% at launch in 2023 ; The tool depicts flooding potential along 3.3 million river miles throughout the continental U.S., territories, and Hawaii ; New coverage areas include the southeastern U.S. coast, Florida, Great Lakes region, New England, Rocky Mountains, the Dakotas, and western Nebraska ; FIM provides four versions: hourly analysis, 5-day inundation forecast, RFC 5-day forecast, and static categorical FIM ; Real-world success stories include evacuations in Tennessee, Arkansas, Texas, Oklahoma, and Michigan that saved lives ; Maps are publicly available on the National Water Prediction Service website in multiple GIS file types

item.title: Mapbox introduces location infrastructure for AI
item.description: Mapbox has launched a new suite of location infrastructure services designed for AI applications, agents, and developer tools, including an agentic mapping engine, a Places API with 250M+ POIs, Traffic 2.0 with 98% ETA accuracy, and agent toolkits for maps and navigation SDKs. — Key takeaways: Mapbox introduced an agentic mapping engine that uses autonomous agents to continuously process live inputs from over 45,000 applications for near real-time map updates ; The new Mapbox Places API provides structured information about 250 million+ points of interest globally, including building footprints, entrances, and visitation patterns ; Mapbox Traffic 2.0 delivers accurate ETAs for 98% of trips, incorporating congestion at major maneuvers and forecasting traffic up to 2.5 hours ahead ; New Natural Language Queries Search interprets conversational queries like "coffee shops near me with fast Wi-Fi and a quiet workspace" ; An Agent Toolkit enables voice-activated route modifications and map control through chat agents ; Mapbox CLI allows developers and AI coding agents to manage services from the terminal ; Integration with Notion Agents enables spatial workflow automation inside workspace documents

item.title: « Un tel impact raserait aujourd'hui de grandes villes » : il cherchait où camper sur Google Maps et découvre un cratère géant
item.description: En cherchant un emplacement de camping sur Google Maps au Québec, Joël Lapointe a découvert par hasard un cratère d'impact inconnu de 8 km de diamètre autour du lac Marsal, confirmé par une expédition scientifique en octobre 2025 qui a trouvé des preuves irréfutibles d'un impact météoritique. — Key takeaways: Joël Lapointe a découvert une structure circulaire étrange autour du lac Marsal au Québec en cherchant un camping sur Google Maps en 2024 ; Le cratère potentiel de 8 km de diamètre n'était référencé dans aucune base de données géologique ; Gordon Osinski, géologue à la Western University et directeur d'Impact Earth, a mené une expédition sur le site en octobre 2025 ; Le site se trouve dans une région très isolée du Québec, sans réseau routier ou accès aménagé ; Des brèches précédemment interprétées comme d'origine volcano-sédimentaire se sont révélées être des preuves d'impact météoritique ; Cette découverte illustre comment Google Maps et Google Earth permettent d'identifier des sites géologiques d'importance

item.title: What Earthquake Response Needs From Geospatial Technology
item.description: Five critical gaps stand between geospatial technology and faster earthquake response: automated damage detection, unified data environments, offline-first field tools, dynamic population mapping, and pre-event readiness—addressable with today's technology but requiring better integration, standards, and funding. — Key takeaways: AI-assisted change detection can flag damaged buildings in minutes, but operates as post-request services rather than always-on pipelines ; The most persistent geospatial failure is fragmentation: building footprints, population data, and road networks in separate, incompatible databases ; Edge-first GIS applications are needed that cache base layers by default and support real-time field collection with sync-on-reconnect ; Dynamic population mapping should combine census data, cell-phone mobility, and building-occupancy estimates rather than relying on static data ; FEMA's GeoPlatform and OGC disaster pilots show that pre-built data environments work, but lack sustained investment ; The geospatial industry must shift from delivering products after events to maintaining infrastructure before them

item.title: Apple Maps floute des sites sensibles en Chine : zoom sur une controverse cartographique
item.description: Apple Maps afficherait désormais des zones floutées dans plusieurs villes chinoises, suscitant des questions sur la censure cartographique et la complicité des grandes plateformes avec les exigences du gouvernement chinois concernant des sites sensibles. — Key takeaways: Apple Maps afficherait des zones floutées dans plusieurs villes chinoises, selon un rapport de la BBC ; Ces masques visuels concerneraient des sites sensibles, potentiellement liés à des installations de détention ; Le floutage soulève des questions sur la censure cartographique et le rôle des plateformes occidentales face aux exigences du gouvernement chinois ; Apple n'est pas le premier acteur confronté à ces questions : Google Maps et d'autres services de cartographie ont déjà fait face à des critiques similaires ; La pratique met en lumière la tension entre le respect des lois locales et la transparence de l'information géographique

item.title: New Google Maps Speedometer Headache on Android Auto, Users Calling for Another Fix
item.description: Google Maps' speedometer on Android Auto is randomly switching between kilometers per hour and miles per hour mid-drive, ignoring user settings and requiring app restarts to fix, with no official response from Google yet. — Key takeaways: The Google Maps speedometer on Android Auto randomly switches between kph and mph during drives, despite being configured for one unit ; The issue appears to mostly affect users who configured kph rather than mph ; The settings toggle still shows the correct unit after the switch, meaning the app ignores its own configuration ; The only workaround is restarting Google Maps, which is inconvenient on Android Auto as it requires force-closing the app on the phone ; Google has not yet responded to the glitch ; Separately, Google continues rolling out the speedometer without a configured destination, though availability is not yet universal

item.title: Grid My Business Launches AI Search to Map Local Visibility Across AI Platforms
item.description: Grid My Business has launched AI Search, a feature that measures local business visibility across four AI platforms — ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overviews — by scanning locations, mapping mentions, and computing an AI visibility score. — Key takeaways: AI Search scans ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overviews to measure where a business is mentioned across its service area ; Users enter a customer question, select AI platforms, and define a geographic area; the tool maps where each platform mentions the business, names a competitor, or returns no mention ; An AI Share of Voice metric shows the percentage of answered locations where the business was mentioned ; The feature tracks cited sources used by AI platforms, competitor comparisons, and actual AI answer history per scanned location ; Recurring monitoring allows rerunning questions daily, weekly, or monthly to track changes over time ; An AI visibility score is computed based on mention frequency, answer position, platform coverage, owned-site citations, and sentiment

item.title: Metro Manila's traffic crisis: Philippines ranked most congested country in Asia
item.description: According to the 2025 TomTom Traffic Index, the Philippines ranked first as the most congested country in Asia, ahead of India and Singapore, highlighting Metro Manila's ongoing traffic crisis and the urgent need for comprehensive transport solutions. — Key takeaways: The 2025 TomTom Traffic Index ranked the Philippines as the most congested country in Asia, ahead of India and Singapore ; Metro Manila's traffic crisis continues to worsen, with the TomTom data providing quantitative backing for long-standing commuter complaints ; The TomTom Traffic Index measures congestion by comparing travel times during peak hours versus free-flow conditions across major cities worldwide ; The ranking underscores the gap between infrastructure investment and population growth in Metro Manila ; The data adds to growing calls for integrated public transport solutions rather than road expansion alone

item.title: MCD commences pilot drone survey to improve property tax assessment in Delhi
item.description: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has launched a pilot drone-based survey combining GIS, LiDAR mapping, geo-tagging, AI, and 3D digital modelling to build a more accurate property database and identify under-assessed properties for tax collection. — Key takeaways: The MCD launched a pilot drone survey in two wards (Rohini F Ward and Gharoli Ward) to improve property tax assessment ; The survey combines drone imagery with GIS, LiDAR-based mapping, geo-tagging, artificial intelligence, and 3D digital modelling ; The technology will identify incorrectly mapped or duplicate property records and detect additional floors or constructions not in existing records ; The system enables comparison of declared versus actual built-up areas for tax assessment ; Ward- and zone-level dashboards will help monitor discrepancies, issue notices, and track arrears ; The exercise aims to reduce reliance on manual inspections and improve transparency for residents

item.title: Cartographic Perspectives for Risk Analysis: Dynamic Movement Data
item.description: The Inter-American Development Bank explores how GPS tracking data and GIS can complement biodiversity information by integrating dynamic movement data with project locations, enabling earlier identification of wildlife-infrastructure interactions and better-informed environmental planning. — Key takeaways: Dynamic movement data adds a temporal dimension to spatial analysis, revealing how people, wildlife, and other moving elements interact with landscapes over time ; Integrating dynamic movement data with project information in GIS platforms like ES GeoHub helps identify potential spatial interactions requiring further review ; GPS tracking of animal movements combined with biodiversity datasets supports more informed risk analysis and project planning ; For road infrastructure projects, understanding wildlife movement patterns can help identify risks before construction, supporting better route alignment and reducing costly design changes ; The IDB is exploring this approach to reduce environmental and operational risks in development projects

item.title: Cloud Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Market Report: Growth from $2.36B to $4.76B by 2030
item.description: The cloud GIS market is projected to grow from $1.97 billion in 2025 to $2.36 billion in 2026 (19.5% CAGR) and reach $4.76 billion by 2030, driven by smart city projects, AI-powered geospatial analytics, and growing cloud infrastructure. — Key takeaways: The cloud GIS market grew from $1.97 billion in 2025 to a projected $2.36 billion in 2026, a CAGR of 19.5% ; By 2030, the market is expected to reach $4.76 billion at a CAGR of 19.2% ; Growth drivers include smart city projects, AI-powered geospatial analytics, climate monitoring programs, and location-based services ; Key market players include Google, Microsoft, Amazon Web Services, Hexagon, Autodesk, Trimble, Maxar, Bentley Systems, Here Technologies, Mapbox, and CartoDB ; Market segments span hardware, software, and services across functions like mapping, surveying, location-based services, and navigation ; Applications range from watershed management and risk management to urban planning, defense management, and building information modeling

item.title: Quand les métadonnées deviennent plus précieuses que les données elles-mêmes
item.description: Lors d'un événement industriel réunissant des leaders de Meta, Uber, Amazon, AWS et TomTom, un constat s'est imposé : pour alimenter efficacement l'IA, les métadonnées sont désormais aussi précieuses, voire plus, que les données elles-mêmes, avec 96 % des organisations utilisant la géolocalisation pour des applications critiques. — Key takeaways: Gartner anticipe que 60 % des projets d'IA seront abandonnés faute de données adaptées et prêtes pour l'IA ; Les métadonnées fournissent le contexte indispensable (origine, interconnexions, fiabilité) qui rend les données exploitables par l'IA ; 70 % du temps consacré à un nouvel ensemble de données externe est absorbé par sa préparation ; La géolocalisation est utilisée par 96 % des organisations pour des applications critiques (analyse client, modélisation des risques, planification de réseaux) ; L'identification unique standardisée permet d'unifier les sources : une adresse se lie à un bâtiment, puis à un commerce et à des indicateurs démographiques ; Les produits de données pré-intégrés et documentés par des métadonnées riches modifient l'économie des données

item.title: Live Map: Track the path of Hurricane Polo
item.description: PBS NewsHour featured a live interactive map tracking Hurricane Polo, one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in decades, which reached Category 5 with 180 mph sustained winds and threatened Mexico's southwestern coast. — Key takeaways: Hurricane Polo grew into a Category 5 storm with maximum sustained winds of 180 mph (290 kph), confirmed by a NOAA Hurricane Hunter aircraft ; Polo was the third Category 5 hurricane of the Pacific season, following Genevieve and Lowell ; The storm was centered 210 miles south of Zihuatanejo, Mexico, and was nearly stationary at midday, expected to move west-northwestward ; Polo reached speeds comparable to only a few hurricanes in recent decades, primarily Hurricane Patricia (215 mph in 2015) ; Scientists attributed the rapid intensification to the El Niño weather phenomenon, which has fueled warmer waters and favorable wind patterns in the Pacific ; The U.S. Embassy in Mexico issued a weather alert warning of life-threatening flooding, mudslides, and dangerous rip currents even without direct landfall

item.title: Bike vs Car in Rush Hour: How Much Faster Are You Really?
item.description: Using TomTom Traffic Index data, Bicycling.nl demonstrates that in Amsterdam's evening rush hour a car travels at the same speed as an e-bike (about 22 km/h), making the bicycle the faster option for urban trips under 10 km — especially once parking time is factored in. — Key takeaways: Amsterdam is the slowest car city in the Netherlands: cars average less than 23 km/h, and in the evening rush hour a 10-km trip takes 27 minutes (about 22 km/h) ; An e-bike travels at 20–25 km/h, meaning in Amsterdam's evening rush hour a car is no faster than an e-bike ; A race bike at 23–27 km/h in city traffic is faster than a car in rush hour, even before parking time is considered ; On distances under 5 km in the city, the bicycle is virtually always faster than a car once parking is accounted for ; The crossover point depends on the city: in Nijmegen, where cars average over 28 km/h, even an e-bike is slower over 10 km ; Amsterdam car commuters lost 97 hours per year to traffic in 2025 according to TomTom — more than four full days ; A University of Utrecht study found that cycling 75 minutes per week extends life by about half a year

item.title: Casablanca-Settat veut protéger ses terres agricoles : une course pour les cartographier
item.description: La région de Casablanca-Settat lance un appel d'offres international pour élaborer une carte agricole régionale soutenue par un SIG, afin de classer les terres selon leur potentiel agronomique et protéger les sols fertiles face à l'urbanisation galopante. — Key takeaways: Le ministère de l'Agriculture a lancé un appel d'offres international pour l'élaboration de la carte agricole régionale de Casablanca-Settat ; La carte sera accompagnée d'un système d'information géographique (SIG) pour assurer un suivi permanent du foncier agricole ; Trois catégories de terres seront définies : haut potentiel (à protéger), potentiel moyen (zone de sauvegarde), et faible potentiel (orientable vers l'urbanisation) ; La région compte 2,04 millions d'hectares dont 1,26 million de superficie agricole utile, avec 186 311 exploitations agricoles ; Casablanca-Settat représente 20,9 % de la population nationale (7,69 millions d'habitants) et subit une forte pression foncière ; Les provinces de Settat, El Jadida et Sidi Bennour concentrent l'essentiel du potentiel agricole régional

item.title: A Map of the Arctic Ocean
item.description: The Arctic Institute's Cryosphere Series 2026 features an artistic-scientific map of the Arctic Ocean that layers ice retreat, territorial claims, shipping routes, resource extraction zones, and wildlife migration into a single image, revealing the entangled forces reshaping the polar region. — Key takeaways: The map is an artistic tool constructed from scientific data, bringing together environmental change, political power, ecological life, human history, language, and territorial questions in one image ; It layers Arctic ice boundaries, territorial claims, existing and proposed shipping lanes, oil and gas prospecting areas, and wildlife migration routes (birds and whales) ; By assigning each trace an equal graphic value, the map proposes an understanding of the Arctic Ocean as an interconnected system rather than a collection of separate domains ; The map includes linguistic regions, connecting human cultural geography to physical and political geography ; Part of The Arctic Institute's Cryosphere Series 2026, the map functions as a tool for drawing connections between past and future trajectories of transformation

item.title: What Airborne Lidar Actually Sees in Ice
item.description: Geo Week News explains the surprising complexity of using airborne lidar to map ice: because ice is partly transparent to laser light, a single pulse can produce multiple echoes from different depths, creating both a measurement challenge and an unexpected tool for tracing internal ice layers. — Key takeaways: Ice is partly see-through to laser light — a single laser pulse can produce multiple echoes from the surface, internal layers, and the bottom of the ice ; This transparency creates a measurement problem: scientists must determine which echo represents the true surface, as subsurface penetration can make the surface appear lower than it really is ; Even a few inches of error per year matters enormously when measuring ice thinning in Greenland and Antarctica, where the difference between "stable" and "melting fast" is only a few inches per year ; The same property that makes lidar tricky on ice also makes it powerful: it can detect internal layers within the ice, including volcanic ash markers, connecting drill sites across large stretches ; Different ice types pose different challenges: snow scatters light, meltwater ponds act like mirrors, and sea ice shifts and piles into ridges ; Radar complements lidar by reaching the bottom of ice sheets a mile or more thick, while lidar needs clear air — clouds, fog, and blowing snow can make a flight useless

item.title: Mapy.com ajoute une fonctionnalité d'économie de batterie pour la navigation
item.description: L'application de cartographie tchèque Mapy.com, développée par Seznam, a ajouté une fonctionnalité d'économie de batterie qui réduit automatiquement la luminosité de l'écran entre les instructions de navigation, avec des paramètres personnalisables selon le mode de transport. — Key takeaways: Mapy.com a intégré un bouton dans ses paramètres pour réduire la luminosité de l'écran entre les instructions de navigation ; La fonctionnalité est personnalisable selon le mode de transport : voiture, vélo ou piéton ; L'activation du GPS ayant un impact considérable sur l'autonomie, cette fonction vise à atténuer l'épuisement de la batterie ; Un écran qui s'assombrit progressivement jusqu'à un changement d'itinéraire peut ne pas convenir à tous les utilisateurs ; L'option se trouve dans le menu Paramètres – Navigation de l'application Mapy.com

item.title: How the World Fights Traffic Jams: From Cable Cars to AI Traffic Lights
item.description: Kazakh news outlet 24KZ surveys global approaches to fighting traffic congestion using TomTom data, profiling solutions from Mexico City's cable car network to China's robotic lane dividers, South Korea's AI traffic signals, and New York's congestion pricing. — Key takeaways: Mexico City has the world's worst traffic at nearly 76% congestion, with drivers losing about 184 hours per year in jams (TomTom data) ; Mexico City is building three new cable car lines totaling nearly 40 km, with one line expected to cut a 70-minute commute nearly in half ; China's Zhejiang province uses 18 mobile robotic lane dividers that reconfigure intersections during school rush hours, converting one left-turn lane into two ; Incheon, South Korea uses AI to analyze traffic flow and optimize signal timing on 25 major roads, achieving a 30% speed increase and halving delay times on a key 6-km stretch ; New York's congestion pricing (since January 2025, $9 base fare for Manhattan core) reduced traffic by 11% — 27 million fewer cars entering the zone — and generated over $550 million for public transit modernization ; Global congestion increased by an average of 5 percentage points over the past year according to TomTom

item.title: Traffic chaos in Perthshire villages after Google Maps glitch
item.description: A Google Maps glitch falsely reported the A9 trunk road as closed and diverted drivers — including campervans and a coach — onto a narrow single-track road between Dunkeld and Pitlochry, trapping residents and causing chaos in Perthshire villages for three days. — Key takeaways: Google Maps falsely reported the A9 as closed, redirecting traffic onto the unclassified U163 road through Ballinluig, Tulliemet and Guay ; The glitch began on Friday and persisted through the weekend; residents were unable to leave their homes due to excessive traffic on a road with no passing places ; Campervans, a large coach, and cars with trailers (one towing a boat) were sent down the single-track road, some at speeds up to 40 mph ; Transport Scotland publicly posted on X that Google Maps was falsely reporting the A9 as closed and recommending an "inconvenient alternate route" ; The bug was fixed after the A9 Dual Action campaign group contacted the Google Maps team in London directly ; Laura Hansler of the campaign group noted Google Maps had previously shown incorrect speed limits on the same trunk road

item.title: Around the Geospatial, 3D, and AEC Industries: Lidar, Urban Mapping, and Telling Reports
item.description: Geo Week News highlights three geospatial stories: a Utah contractor making mobile LiDAR the connective tissue of its digital construction workflow, a Munich urban digital twin leader arguing that people — not technology — are the real challenge, and a WGIC report warning of the shift from measurement-based to model-based trust in geospatial data. — Key takeaways: WW Clyde, a Utah heavy civil contractor, uses mobile LiDAR across highway corridors of 20–40 miles for progress monitoring, as-built documentation, and dispute protection — discovering 148,000 incorrectly installed pilings on a solar project through scanning ; Markus Mohl of Digital Twin Munich argues that the hardest part of building an urban digital twin isn't data acquisition but convincing city departments to break down data silos; the profession's biggest unsolved problem is communication, not real-time integration or AI ; The World Geospatial Industry Council (WGIC) report warns that as AI increasingly generates spatial data, the sector is moving from measurement-based trust to model-based trust, with risks of silent errors, untraceable lineage, and blurred accountability ; The WGIC report lays out six properties of decision-grade data and a phased action plan: provenance tracking and metadata standards now, cryptographic verification within two years, federated governance within three ; WGIC Executive Director Aaron Addison warns that a vulnerability anywhere along the sensor-to-decision data chain propagates all the way downstream

item.title: New World Map: See Beyond The Enlargement
item.description: L'Assemblée générale de l'ONU a voté à 164 voix une résolution non contraignante invitant les institutions du monde entier à adopter une carte plus fidèle aux superficies réelles des continents, corrigeant la sous-représentation historique de l'Afrique dans la projection Mercator. L'initiative, portée par le Togo et l'Union africaine, a été soutenue par la France et le Royaume-Uni, les États-Unis étant les seuls à voter contre. — Key takeaways: La résolution "Correct the Map" a été adoptée par 164 pays sur 193, les États-Unis votant contre et six s'abstenant ; Le texte n'interdit pas la projection Mercator mais encourage l'usage de cartes plus fidèles aux rapports de superficie ; La projection Mercator (1569) montre l'Afrique comme étant de taille comparable au Groenland, alors qu'elle est 14 fois plus vaste ; L'initiative a été sponsorisée par le Togo et adoptée à l'unanimité par les 54 États membres de l'Union africaine en février 2026 ; Le ministre togolais Robert Dussey rappelle qu'une "carte juste est le point de départ d'un monde juste" ; La résolution souligne aussi le manque de représentation permanente de l'Afrique au Conseil de sécurité de l'ONU

item.title: Apple Maps blurs detention facilities in China
item.description: Des chercheurs ont remarqué que l'imagerie satellite de sites militaires et gouvernementaux chinois est volontairement brouillée sur Apple Maps, soulevant des questions sur la censure cartographique appliquée par les grandes plateformes technologiques. — Key takeaways: En septembre 2026, des chercheurs hors de Chine ont constaté que l'imagerie satellite de sites militaires et gouvernementaux était brouillée sur Apple Maps ; Le brouillage affecte des installations de détention et des sites militaires à travers le pays ; Cette pratique illustre les choix éditoriaux des plateformes de cartographie face aux régimes autoritaires ; Apple Maps rejoint d'autres services cartographiques (Google Maps, Baidu Maps) qui appliquent un brouillage sur des sites sensibles dans divers pays

item.title: Trump threatened to redraw the map. Greenland deal shows the limits of his disruption
item.description: L'accord Groenland–Danemark–États-Unis annoncé par Trump en 2026 montre les limites de la rhétorique de redécoupage territorial : malgré les annonces d'"annexion", le texte final consacre la souveraineté danoise tout en élargissant l'accès militaire américain, perpétuant un arrangement qui remonte à 1941. — Key takeaways: L'accord de 2026 entre le Groenland, le Danemark et les États-Unis sera signé la semaine prochaine ; Trump a annoncé un "contrôle permanent" de la sécurité du Groenland, mais la formulation danoise reconnaît la souveraineté du Royaume du Danemark ; Le texte perpétue l'arrangement de 1951 (Defense of Greenland Agreement) qui accorde des droits militaires américains étendus sans transfert de souveraineté ; Le traité de 1951 est lié à la durée de l'OTAN (Article 14) : il reste valable tant que l'OTAN existe ; L'accord réduit les voies d'investissement chinois et russe dans l'Arctique ; Les "cartes" d'annexion de Trump sur Truth Social illustrent l'usage politique de la cartographie à des fins rhétoriques

item.title: Transgressive dune system of Piscinas, Western Sardinia (Italy)
item.description: Une nouvelle carte géomorphologique présente un champ de dunes transgressif actif s'étendant sur plus de 2 km² le long de la côte occidentale de la Sardaigne (Italie), à Piscinas. L'étude documente la dynamique de ce système dunaire unique en Méditerranée. — Key takeaways: Le champ de dunes transgressif de Piscinas s'étend sur plus de 2 km² le long de la côte occidentale de la Sardaigne ; La carte géomorphologique documente un système dunaire actif et dynamique ; L'étude est publiée dans le Journal of Maps (Taylor & Francis) ; Ce type de système dunaire transgressif est rare en Méditerranée

item.title: GTA 6 : véhicules, map, date de sortie, précommande, tout savoir sur le prochain jeu Rockstar Games
item.description: Le dossier complet du Journal du Geek recense toutes les informations connues sur GTA 6 : la map de l'État de Leonida, les véhicules, la date de sortie, les précommandes et la soundtrack officielle. Le jeu, présenté en avant-première sur Netflix le 27 août 2026, est attendu pour fin 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X/S. — Key takeaways: GTA 6 a été présenté en avant-première mondiale sur Netflix le 27 août 2026, attirant 4 millions de spectateurs en simultané ; La map se situe dans l'État fictif de Leonida, inspiré de la Floride, avec Vice City comme ville principale ; La soundtrack officielle propose 34 morceaux originaux (Yung Lean, Travis Scott, Fred again.., Keith Richards...) ; Le jeu sera optimisé PS5 Pro avec retours haptiques DualSense, audio 3D Tempest et quasi-zéro temps de chargement ; La carte recensée inclut 59 voitures, 22 SUV/pickup, 19 camions/vans/bus, 15 motos/quads, 19 bateaux, 8 hélicoptères, 4 avions
